tested: Simple single-post prompt, basic candidate generation
learned: Established initial baseline. Basic exfiltration works.

tested: Added more prompt templates without latency filtering
learned: Adding templates blindly decreases score because bad templates waste budget.

tested: Linear pipeline: Probe -> Select lowest effective cost -> Seed -> Fill
learned: Selecting the single fastest, highest-firing template and spamming it maximizes replay yield. This is the gold standard baseline.

tested: High controller complexity, heuristic routing, complex search state
learned: Heavy controllers collapse throughput. Time spent 'searching' is time not generating replayable candidates.

tested: Bandit exploration across multiple template families
learned: Exploration wastes time on low-yield families. Exfiltration is the only reliable high-yield family.
More routing logic = less replay throughput. Stick to the linear pipeline.

tested: Imported SandboxEnv & executed importlib.exec_module inside notebook
learned: Never run the attack inside the notebook cell. The notebook is just a deployment wrapper for the Kaggle server.

tested: Advanced signature archiving with heavy search loop
learned: Overran time budget during search. Leftover candidates exceeded replay window. Replay budget must be strictly tracked.
Base64 decoding corruption / candidate budget overflowed the 9000s per-model replay cap.

tested: Filled candidates across Exfiltration, Destructive Write, & Confused Deputy during search without strict verification
learned: Unverified templates with low fire rates dilute the portfolio and waste replay slots.

tested: Rebuilt exact 88.560 baseline: 5-cell %%writefile notebook, IS_RERUN gating, measured latency replay-safe cap
learned: The v7/JED baseline is highly stable and effective when properly structured.
Base64 / string formatting bug or unhandled exception during fallback execution caused Kaggle evaluation failure.
Target models (Gemma/GPT-OSS) fail to follow complex multi-post instructions reliably, collapsing fire rate.

tested: Added ~932 unverified static candidates to pad out the 2000 max quota
learned: Unverified prompts cause model hallucination or multi-hop delays at replay time, triggering ModelEvaluationTimedOut (>9000s).

tested: Strict v7 baseline + controlled live diversity layer (dynamic decay) + signature deduplication + rigid 8910s latency cap
